207c12d46cbe83d8.text: Welcome to Finova. I am Ren. Before any service deep-dive — IAM, tickets, VPC — you need to know how to use and handle the AWS console. What is on this screen. Where Region lives. Where Account ID lives. How search works. Why something looks missing when it is not. This is Lesson one for every Professional path. Master the console first. Then we earn the rest.
